text:
alex_chen: Hi @people-ops — I just received a final custody order that adds my stepdaughter as my dependent. How do I add her to Redwood benefits? I need coverage retroactive to her birthdate (2025-01-10).

maria_hr: Congrats and thanks for flagging this, alex. Short checklist we usually need: final custody order, dependent's birth certificate, SSN (or last 4), and proof of address if the order references residency.

alex_chen: Thanks — can I upload those docs somewhere? Concerned about sharing SSN over email.

jess_benefits: You can upload securely via the benefits portal in Workday: Benefits > Manage Dependents > Add Dependent > Upload Documents. If you're not seeing the option ping us and we'll open a case. If you prefer email, send to benefits@redwood.com using the subject exactly: "Add dependent - alex_chen - stepdaughter" and we'll provide a secure upload link. :lock: 

alex_chen: If I mail a scanned PDF, do you need the full SSN or is last 4 OK?

kyle_ops: Last 4 is fine for initial intake, but HR/legal may request full SSN for carrier enrollment if the carrier requires it. We'll give you a secure link for full SSN upload.

maria_hr: Important timeline note: adding a dependent for a qualifying life event (court order) typically must be completed within 30 days of the event to get prospective coverage; requests for retro coverage are reviewed case-by-case. If you want retro to birth date, include the custody order and a short explanation of dates in your email.

alex_chen: Got it — custody order was finalized on 2025-02-05. What do I put in the email body? Any template?

jess_benefits: Quick template below — paste into your email body and attach scans. Keep attachments labeled (e.g., "court_order_alex_chen.pdf").

```
Subject: Add dependent - alex_chen - stepdaughter
Body:
Hi Benefits team,
Please add my stepdaughter, [Full name], DOB: 2025-01-10, to my benefits per final custody order attached (date finalized: 2025-02-05). Documents attached: final custody order, birth certificate, SSN (last 4 or full via secure link), proof of address. Please confirm next steps and whether retro coverage to 2025-01-10 is possible.
Thanks,
Alex Chen
```

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: #HR-84271 (Benefits intake). A benefits specialist will follow up within 2 business days.

alex_chen: Appreciate it. If retro isn't approved, what's the fallback? Can I add her to FSA/HSA or dental separately?

maria_hr: If retro is not approved by the carrier, you can still enroll her prospectively effective date determined by the carrier (often the first of next month after processing). Dental/vision carriers sometimes allow different effective dates — we'll list carrier-specific options once we intake. FSA/HSA changes follow the same QLE timelines.

jess_benefits: One more thing — redact unrelated personal info before upload if needed. If you want us to intake on your behalf, attach scans and we'll confirm receipt and next steps. :white_check_mark: 

alex_chen: Sending docs now via secure link. Thanks team! :pray:
